Browse all 10 FAQs
What information is needed to start?

A brief description of your business, your goals, the services you need, and any existing website or brand materials is a useful start. We’ll clarify content, features, budget, and responsibilities during discovery.

How is the delivery timeline decided?

Starter Website delivery is 48 hours, Business Website delivery is 3–4 days, and Custom Website delivery is 7 days. Timings begin once scope is confirmed and the required content and access are received. Any changes to scope or dependencies are discussed before the schedule is adjusted.

What does ongoing maintenance include?

Support is available 24 hours a day, with replies within 6 hours. Maintenance coverage depends on your support plan: we’ll specify the monitoring, updates, backups if included, and any content changes covered. New features or work outside that scope are quoted separately.

Can the AI assistant answer questions about my business?

An AI assistant is included in the ₹4,999 Business and ₹11,999 Custom tiers. It is optional and quoted separately for the ₹1,999 Starter tier. It can be configured around business information you approve, such as services, policies, and FAQs. We’ll agree on boundaries and how it directs visitors to human help. AI can make mistakes, so important answers should be checked and maintained.

What happens if AI usage exceeds the agreed allowance?

We agree on usage allowances, monitoring, and overage handling before launch. The plan will specify whether usage is capped, paused, or continued at an agreed additional cost, and how you’re notified.
